say:1:1622408001:1.text: Are you here to practice magic?
say:1:1622408001:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，您是来这里练习魔法的吗？
say:1:1622408001:1.male: Are you here to practice magic?

say:3:1622408002:1.text: Professor Hepler? I saw him camping nearby a couple of days ago. He seemed pretty relaxed, actually.
say:3:1622408002:1.source_cn: 赫普老师？我前两天的确在附近遇到过他，他好像在露营，看...
say:3:1622408002:1.male: Professor Hepler? I saw him camping nearby a couple of days ago. He seemed pretty relaxed, actually.
say:3:1622408002:1.female: Professor Hepler? I saw him camping nearby a couple of days ago. He seemed pretty relaxed, actually.

say:4:1622408003:1.text: But... have you noticed what's going on out here? Something is up.
say:4:1622408003:1.source_cn: 不过，梅林大人，您注意到这里的状况了吗？发生了一些异常。
say:4:1622408003:1.male: But... have you noticed what's going on out here? Something is up.
say:4:1622408003:1.female: But... have you noticed what's going on out here? Something is up.

say:6:1622408007:1.text: From what I can tell, there was a big storm and a <style="highlight">migrating flock</style> got caught in it.
say:6:1622408007:1.source_cn: 根据我的观察，前两天有场很大的风暴，一个<style=...

say:6:1622408007:1.female: From what I can tell, there was a big storm and a <style="highlight">migrating flock</style> got caught in it.

say:7:1622408008:1.text: A lot of them injured their wings and they were forced to land here.
say:7:1622408008:1.source_cn: 它们许多成员的翅膀受了伤，暂时失去了飞行能力，被迫降落在这。
say:7:1622408008:1.male: A lot of them injured their wings and they were forced to land here.
say:7:1622408008:1.female: A lot of them injured their wings and they were forced to land here.

say:8:1622408009:1.text: <style="highlight">I've been taking care of them for days.</style> Look, this one's already healing up! And those over there? They're doing much better.
say:8:1622408009:1.male: <style="highlight">I've been taking care of them for days.</style> Look, this one's already healing up! And those over there? They're doing much better.
say:8:1622408009:1.female: <style="highlight">I've been taking care of them for days.</style> Look, this one's already healing up! And those over there? They're doing much better.

choice_prompt:9:1622408009.text: <style="highlight">I've been taking care of them for days.</style> Look, this one's already healing up! And those over there? They're doing much better.
choice_prompt:9:1622408009.source_cn: <style=highlight>我已经照顾它们好几天了</style>。你看，这只翅膀的伤口已经开始愈合了，还有那边那几只，精神也好多了。
choice_prompt:9:1622408009.male: <style="highlight">I've been taking care of them for days.</style> Look, this one's already healing up! And those over there? They're doing much better.
choice_prompt:9:1622408009.female: <style="highlight">I've been taking care of them for days.</style> Look, this one's already healing up! And those over there? They're doing much better.

say:10:1622408010:1.text: Thank you, Magister Merlin! I'll take extra good care of them!
say:10:1622408010:1.source_cn: 嗯！有梅林大人的鼓励，我会加倍努力帮助它们的！
say:10:1622408010:1.male: Thank you, Magister Merlin! I'll take extra good care of them!
say:10:1622408010:1.female: Thank you, Magister Merlin! I'll take extra good care of them!

say:11:1622408011:1.text: A little more time, and they will be back in the sky, carrying on <style="highlight">south</style>.
say:11:1622408011:1.source_cn: 只要再过一段时间，它们应该就能重新飞起来，继续<sty...
say:11:1622408011:1.male: A little more time, and they will be back in the sky, carrying on <style="highlight">south</style>.
say:11:1622408011:1.female: A little more time, and they will be back in the sky, carrying on <style="highlight">south</style>.

say:12:1622408015:1.text: They've got miles ahead of them. Being grounded now could cost them the whole migration.
say:12:1622408015:1.source_cn: 迁徙对候鸟来说是件大事，可不能因为受伤就耽误了。
say:12:1622408015:1.male: They've got miles ahead of them. Being grounded now could cost them the whole migration.
say:12:1622408015:1.female: They've got miles ahead of them. Being grounded now could cost them the whole migration.

say:14:1622408016:1.text: Cassadee is still speaking when a low, measured voice comes from the trees.
say:14:1622408016:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂的话音未落，一个沉稳而略带严厉的声音从不远处传来。
say:14:1622408016:1.male: Cassadee is still speaking when a low, measured voice comes from the trees.
say:14:1622408016:1.female: Cassadee is still speaking when a low, measured voice comes from the trees.

say:21:1622408012:1.text: Really? They are in better hands, then!
say:21:1622408012:1.source_cn: 好呀，有梅林大人的帮助，它们会恢复得更快的！
say:21:1622408012:1.male: Really? They are in better hands, then!
say:21:1622408012:1.female: Really? They are in better hands, then!

say:22:1622408013:1.text: A little more time, and they will be back in the sky, carrying on <style="highlight">south</style>.
say:22:1622408013:1.source_cn: 只要再过一段时间，它们应该就能重新飞起来，继续<sty...

say:22:1622408013:1.female: A little more time, and they will be back in the sky, carrying on <style="highlight">south</style>.

say:23:1622408014:1.text: Um...? But they're hurt, Magister Merlin. With a little help, they can take off sooner and continue <style="highlight">south</style>.
say:23:1622408014:1.source_cn: 嗯？梅林大人，可是那些候鸟受伤了，有我的帮助，它们能更...

choice:9:2:3.text: I don't think we should step in.
choice:9:2:3.male: I don't think we should step in.
choice:9:2:3.female: I don't think we should step in.

say:24:1622408004:1.text: And that's what makes you a Magister! I'm not slacking either!
say:24:1622408004:1.source_cn: 不愧是梅林大人，真是勤勉，我也有在努力呢！
say:24:1622408004:1.male: And that's what makes you a Magister! I'm not slacking either!
say:24:1622408004:1.female: And that's what makes you a Magister! I'm not slacking either!

say:25:1622408005:1.text: Surely you have noticed something's up, haven't you?
say:25:1622408005:1.source_cn: 您一定也注意到这附近存在一些异常状况了吧？
say:25:1622408005:1.male: Surely you have noticed something's up, haven't you?
